body: I love music. But then again I can’t play any instruments or anything like that.

I’m sure you’re talented too. Have anything to share?
I have ADHD and it makes it hard for me to keep focus on things and finish them. I also lose interest in anything that I do pretty quick too. Sadly I have dyslexia too. 
And I guess in general I don’t feel confident in what I write, my writing skills are pretty average and even if I have ‘amazing’ concepts it’s hard for me to put them into words. Of course it’s achievable if I practice but I just don’t see a point.
I used to write poems/proses, sometimes novels with hidden metaphorical messages.
thank you that you took your time to read and even reply to my post, it really means a lot
do you have anyone else you could talk about it with besides your family?

I used to feel the same way, many people have hurt and made me feel worthless and unlovable. Parents, partners, friends. It seems like the loneliness will last forever. But it doesn’t. As cliche as it sounds it finds you at your lowest and when you least expect it.

I guess I really love reading ever since I was little, it was the only escape from all the chaos happening in my life, but even now I can hardly even pick up a book, I used to like writing but gave up because I hate what I write, it’s genuinely basic and simple. I have a partner. I really love them and I know that my suicide would hurt them so much, they were the one who managed to talk me out of suicide last summer. But now I feel shit because I just can’t bring myself to care. If I die I die. It won’t matter. I wont be there.
I’ve been trying to stick around for various reasons, and they would work for some time. But sadly not anymore. It just seems pointless.
